Daily Devotional

March 26

13 He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever. 14 I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men: 15 But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee. (2 Samuel 7:13-15 KJV)

This is the promise from God to David that his son Solomon would build the House of the Lord, and that God promised not to forsake the heirs of David, like He did Saul, and that the Seed of David (Jesus) would be on the throne of His kingdom forever. This was an important promise that God upheld, as Solomon did stray from God in his later years (1 Kings 11:3-4), but God was faithful to the promise to David and did not rescind this promise. This is so very important a promise, as many of the descendants of David fell short of serving our true God, yet God, who can not lie (Titus 1:2), kept His promise.

The integrity of our Heavenly Father is so awesome. When He makes a promise, He stays with it, and that gives us believers an assurance that our salvation, as well as our blessings that He has given us, is without repentance. The Word of God is the most sure thing that this world has ever seen, or will ever see. If you can’t depend of God’s promises then there is nothing that you can depend on. The Word of God holds this entire universe together (Colossians 1:17), and is the only sure thing in this world. Thank you Lord for your integrity.
